name: Adobe Stock File
description: Schema for an Adobe Stock file record as returned by the Adobe Stock Search API. Represents a stock asset such as a photo, illustration, vector, video, or template including its metadata, creator information, dimensions, thumbnail URLs, and licensing status.

id.description: Unique Adobe Stock content identifier assigned to this file

title.description: Title of the stock file as provided by the contributor
examples: Beautiful mountain landscape at sunrise with fog in the valley

creator_name.description: Display name of the contributor who created and uploaded this stock file

creator_id.description: Unique identifier of the contributor on Adobe Stock

country_name.description: Country of origin of the contributor as listed in their Adobe Stock profile

width.description: Original width of the stock file in pixels (for images and video)

height.description: Original height of the stock file in pixels (for images and video)

media_type_id.description: Numeric identifier for the media type: 1=photo, 2=illustration, 3=vector, 4=video, 6=3D, 7=template

content_type.description: MIME type of the stock file

keywords.description: List of keyword objects describing the content and subject matter of the file

items.description: A single keyword associated with this stock file

comp_url.description: URL of the watermarked comp image for preview and design mockup purposes. The comp is a lower-resolution, watermarked version of the full file.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the small thumbnail image used in search result lists

thumbnail_width.description: Width of the thumbnail image in pixels

thumbnail_height.description: Height of the thumbnail image in pixels

thumbnail_500_url.description: URL of a medium-size (500px) preview image

thumbnail_1000_url.description: URL of a larger (1000px) preview image

is_licensed.description: Licensing status of this file for the authenticated user. Empty string if not licensed.

vector_type.description: Vector file subtype for vector and illustration assets. Empty string for non-vector assets.

category.description: Primary category classification of this stock file

name.description: Localized display name of the category

is_editorial.description: Whether this asset is editorial use only (not for commercial purposes)

has_releases.description: Whether this asset has model or property releases on file

nb_results.description: Total number of results matching the search query. Only present on the first result in a search response.

examples.title: Beautiful mountain landscape at sunrise with fog in the valley
